properties.name: The open ideas are settled on his word: ten promoted to accepted intent, one closed as answered, one given the status its promotion should have set
properties.rationale: Anthony 2026-09-20, on a plain-English readback of the twelve open ideas with a recommendation on each: 'Agree with all your recommendations.'
properties.summary: Ten Requirements accepted with the owner as approver, each carrying the option chosen on its EVOLVES_INTO edge from the idea it came from; the two already built (the shell door and the skill finder) wired to the intent they satisfy, which also clears their unmotivated-capability state; the four-status-contracts idea superseded as answered by v0.65.0; the memory-boundary idea moved to accepted, the status its own promotion on 2026-09-19 should have set and did not.
